description: This Java class 'AnyCommand' provides a GUI component for entering and sending commands, with support for command history, validation, and command preparation (including evaluation and expression conversion). It interacts with external command queue and logging systems.

classes.name: AnyCommand
classes.description: A GUI component for command input, supporting command execution, validation, and command history.

methods.name: prepareCommand
methods.description: Prepares raw command string, handling 'eval' and 'set_fsio_expression' commands by converting them to RPN or postfix expressions.

methods.name: prepareSetFsioCommand
methods.description: Converts 'set_fsio_expression' command to 'set_rpn_expression' with infix to postfix conversion.

methods.name: prepareEvalCommand
methods.description: Converts 'eval' command to 'rpn_eval' with infix to postfix conversion.

methods.name: infix2postfix
methods.description: Converts infix expression to postfix using DoubleEvaluator.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Removes quotes from a quoted string.

methods.name: isValidInput
methods.description: Checks if input contains only ASCII characters.
